topics.title: Send while link previews finish in background

entries.title: Send while link previews finish in background
entries.rationale: Accepted as a security-sensitive lifecycle change, queued for Zion-preserving adaptation. The exactly-once send state machine, community reset, upload cancellation ownership, stale-generation fence, and existing preview URL/size/sanitization guards must be verified together.
security_reasons: background link-preview metadata and media upload network egress
native cancellation registry now accepts cancellation before upload begin and requires explicit release
exactly-once publication and stale-generation fencing protect message payload integrity
community-boundary reset must prevent work or media tags crossing relays

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after dedicated link-preview/media lifecycle threat review, focused cancellation/race tests, dependency/egress screening, visible-Zion checks, compatibility checks, and desktop/Tauri gates.

verification: Full-SHA diff, changed Rust/TypeScript state machines and race tests, existing network guards, dependency impact, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; automated security-access report not claimed because its advisory was interrupted; no source implementation made.
